about: Explanations of every entity of Home Assistant's Reolink integration (HA 2026.10.1, reolink-aio 0.21.18), keyed by domain and translation_key. 'verification' is 'verified' when the HA docs or a Reolink support article confirm what the setting does and the HA/reolink-aio source agrees; otherwise 'unverified', and the text says only what is known.

animal.title: Animal
animal.summary: Turns on while the camera's AI detects an animal.
animal.what_it_does: Reports the camera's own AI animal detection state (reolink-aio `ai_detected`). It is on while the camera reports an animal and off otherwise. HA creates this entity instead of Pet on cameras that report general animal detection; both read the same dog/cat AI channel.
animal.tradeoffs: How often it triggers depends on the camera's AI sensitivity and delay settings for this object type.

sources.title: Reolink: Introduction to Reolink Smart Detection

animal.notes: Push-updated (TCP push, ONVIF push, ONVIF long polling or fast polling), plus a 60-second poll for redundancy.

crossline_dog_cat.title: Crossline animal
crossline_dog_cat.summary: Turns on when an animal crosses the line configured in the Reolink app.
crossline_dog_cat.what_it_does: A line-crossing alert triggers when a target crosses the drawn line. This entity reports that alert for an animal only (reolink-aio `baichuan.smart_ai_state`). Lines/zones and which object types they watch are set up in the Reolink app (Settings > Detection alarm > Smart event detection).
crossline_dog_cat.tradeoffs: Relies on the camera's person/vehicle/animal AI, so tune smart detection sensitivity first.
crossline_dog_cat.requires: Cameras with perimeter protection (line crossing / zone intrusion / zone loitering)

sources.title: Reolink: Comprehensive Guide to Reolink Perimeter Protection and Smart Event Detection

crossline_dog_cat.notes: One entity per line/zone configured in the Reolink app (up to 3); the zone name from the app is shown in the entity name. Entities appear within about 60 seconds of adding a zone in the app. Push-updated.

motion.title: Motion
motion.summary: Turns on while the camera reports motion.
motion.what_it_does: Reports the camera's motion alarm state (reolink-aio `motion_detected`). It is on while the camera detects motion (or a PIR trigger on battery cameras) and off otherwise.
motion.tradeoffs: Plain motion triggers on any movement (shadows, rain, insects); the AI sensors are more selective.
motion.notes: Push-updated (TCP push, ONVIF push, ONVIF long polling or fast polling), plus a 60-second poll for redundancy. Enabled by default; no translation key, HA names it by device class.

sleep.title: Sleep status
sleep.summary: Shows whether a battery camera is currently asleep (standby).
sleep.what_it_does: On while the battery camera is in standby, off while it is awake (reolink-aio `sleeping`, from GetChannelstatus). In standby the camera still detects motion and wakes to record.
sleep.tradeoffs: Useful for spotting automations or dashboards that keep a battery camera awake and drain it.

sources.title: Reolink: Introduction to the Standby Mode of Reolink Battery-powered Cameras

sleep.notes: Diagnostic entity. HA docs suggest it to check that the integration is not waking the camera too often.

pre_siren.requires: Cameras with pre-siren support (battery cameras with smart detection)
pre_siren.impact_note: Makes a warning sound at the camera.

ptz_auto.title: PTZ continuous rotation
ptz_auto.what_it_does: Starts continuous rotation; it keeps rotating until PTZ stop is pressed or this button is pressed again (reolink-aio `PtzCtrl` `Auto`).
ptz_auto.impact_note: The camera keeps sweeping instead of watching one view.
ptz_auto.notes: Disabled by default in HA. Supports the reolink.ptz_move speed action on some models.

ptz_calibrate.title: PTZ calibrate
ptz_calibrate.what_it_does: Runs the camera's PTZ calibration (reolink-aio `PtzCheck`). Reolink says calibration moves the camera to a reference position, then to centre horizontally and vertically, with a model-specific method (not a full rotation in every direction). Reolink suggests it when presets or the guard point drift or movement is not smooth.
ptz_calibrate.tradeoffs: PTZ control is disabled while it runs.
ptz_calibrate.impact_note: The camera moves on its own during calibration and ends at a different view; PTZ control is unavailable meanwhile.

sources.title: Reolink: Introduction to Reolink Camera Calibration

reboot.requires: Cameras, NVRs and Home Hubs that support remote reboot

sync_time.title: Synchronize time
sync_time.summary: Sets the device clock to Home Assistant's time.
sync_time.what_it_does: Writes the Home Assistant host's current local date and time to the camera/NVR, keeping its time zone and display format, then checks it (Baichuan time set). Reolink's own sync uses NTP or the phone's time.
sync_time.requires: Cameras, NVRs and Home Hubs that support it

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set Date/Time for Reolink Products
Reolink: How to Use NTP to Synchronize Time

sync_time.notes: Disabled by default in HA. Fails if the result differs by more than 5 seconds. Check the HA host's time zone matches the camera's.

ext.title: Balanced
ext.summary: The camera's Balanced (mid-resolution) live video stream.
ext.what_it_does: Provides the external (balanced) stream of the camera as a Home Assistant camera entity with live video and still images (reolink-aio `get_stream_source` / `get_snapshot`, stream "ext"). The camera's Balanced stream settings determine its resolution, frame rate and bit rate. Viewing it wakes a battery camera; leaving 'Preload camera stream' on keeps it awake and drains the battery.
ext.tradeoffs: Between Fluent and Clear in quality and bandwidth; not all cameras offer it.

sources.title: Reolink: Introduction to the Difference Between Clear, Fluent and Balanced/Standard Stream

ext.notes: Disabled by default. Unavailable while privacy mode is on. Usually served over FLV or RTMP even when RTSP is selected in the integration options.

volume.what_it_does: On cameras: sets the speaker volume, 0-100, which Reolink says covers both the siren/alarm and the speaker (reolink-aio `set_volume`, AudioCfg `volume`). On a Reolink Chime device: sets the chime volume, 0-4, matching the chime's five levels (Mute, Low, Moderate, Loud, Very Loud) (reolink-aio `Chime.set_option`).

volume.requires: Cameras with a speaker; Reolink Chimes connected to a doorbell or Home Hub

volume_doorbell.what_it_does: Sets a doorbell volume, 0-100 (reolink-aio `set_volume`, AudioCfg `visitorVolume`). Reolink's app has a doorbell ringtone volume on the Sounds page; it is not confirmed that this entity is that exact slider.

zoom.title: Zoom
zoom.summary: Optical zoom position of the lens.
zoom.what_it_does: Moves the optical zoom to an absolute position (reolink-aio `set_zoom`, `StartZoomFocus` `ZoomPos`); the range comes from the camera. Reolink: the camera refocuses automatically after zooming.
zoom.tradeoffs: Zooming in shows more detail but narrows the view, so recordings and detection cover less area.
zoom.impact_note: Changes what the camera sees; recordings and detection cover a different area.

anti_flicker.title: Anti-flicker
anti_flicker.summary: Matches the camera's exposure to your mains power frequency to stop flicker under artificial light.
anti_flicker.what_it_does: Sets the image anti-flicker mode (ISP `antiFlicker` via SetIsp): Off, 50 Hz, 60 Hz or Other. Reolink advises matching your local mains frequency (50 Hz in e.g. the UK and Australia, 60 Hz in the USA and Canada) when lights flicker in the image.
anti_flicker.tradeoffs: Reolink suggests Off for outdoor cameras whose image looks overexposed; a wrong frequency can leave flicker or banding.
anti_flicker.requires: Cameras that report the anti-flicker image setting
anti_flicker.notes: Disabled by default in Home Assistant; enable the entity to use it. Reolink does not document the "Other" option; reolink-aio maps it to the camera's "outdoor" anti-flicker value.

auto_quick_reply_message.title: Auto quick reply message
auto_quick_reply_message.summary: Which recorded quick reply message the doorbell plays automatically when someone presses it, or Off.
auto_quick_reply_message.what_it_does: Sets the doorbell's auto-reply message (SetAutoReply). When the button is pressed and nobody answers, the chosen message plays after the Auto quick reply time; Off disables auto-reply.
auto_quick_reply_message.impact_note: With a message selected, the doorbell answers visitors on its own with that recorded message.

auto_quick_reply_message.notes: Messages are recorded and named in the Reolink app. The list is loaded when the integration starts; restart the Reolink integration after adding messages.

auto_track_method.title: Auto track method
auto_track_method.summary: How a tracking camera follows a subject: digital crop only, digital first, or pan/tilt first.
auto_track_method.what_it_does: Sets the AI tracking method (SetAiCfg `aiTrack`). Digital crops a close-up from the wide lens and never moves the camera; Digital first crops until the subject reaches the edge, then pans/tilts; Pan/tilt first moves the camera to keep the subject centred. Only applies while Auto tracking is on.
auto_track_method.tradeoffs: Pan/tilt methods follow subjects further but move the camera away from its usual view; Digital keeps the view fixed.
auto_track_method.requires: Tracking cameras with selectable methods (TrackMix series and similar)

sources.title: Introduction to Tracking Methods for TrackMix Series Cameras

binning_mode.title: Binning mode
binning_mode.summary: Low-light mode that combines neighbouring sensor pixels to reduce noise at some cost in resolution.
binning_mode.what_it_does: Sets the ISP binning mode (SetIsp `binningMode`) to Off, On or Auto. Binning merges adjacent pixels for a brighter, less noisy image in low light.
binning_mode.tradeoffs: Cleaner low-light image, but reduced detail while binning is active.

sources.title: Introduction to Binning Mode on Reolink Cameras

binning_mode.notes: Disabled by default in Home Assistant; enable the entity to use it. Reolink's article says the app shows only Auto and Off, for the RLC-1212A, RLC-1224A, B1200, P341C, D1200, P345C and CX810; On is exposed by the camera API.

day_night_mode.title: Day night mode
day_night_mode.summary: Whether the camera picks colour or black-and-white (infrared) video automatically, or is forced to one.
day_night_mode.what_it_does: Sets the ISP day/night mode (SetIsp `dayNight`): Auto switches between colour and black-and-white by light level, Color forces colour, Black&White forces night (IR) mode. The Day night switch threshold only applies in Auto.
day_night_mode.tradeoffs: Forcing a mode can be useful under awkward lighting, but leaves video dark at night (Color) or monochrome by day (Black&White).
day_night_mode.impact_note: A forced mode can make recordings dark at night or black-and-white during the day.

doorbell_led.title: Doorbell LED
doorbell_led.summary: When the doorbell's button ring light is lit.
doorbell_led.what_it_does: Sets the doorbell light mode (SetPowerLed `eDoorbellLightState`). Stay off keeps the ring dark; Auto lights it on detection, button press and two-way talk; Auto & always on at night also keeps it lit at night; Always on keeps it lit around the clock.
doorbell_led.tradeoffs: A lit ring helps visitors find the button; Stay off is more discreet.

sources.title: Introduction to the Status Light of Video Doorbell Cameras

doorbell_led.notes: Options depend on the model: Stay off and Always on appear only when the doorbell supports them.

exposure.title: Image exposure mode
exposure.summary: How the camera balances shutter speed and gain: Auto, Low noise, Anti-smearing or Manual.
exposure.what_it_does: Sets the ISP exposure mode (SetIsp `exposure`). Reolink recommends Low noise when the image shows noise specks, Anti-smearing when moving objects smear or ghost, and Manual to use your own gain and shutter ranges.
exposure.tradeoffs: Low noise can increase motion blur; Anti-smearing can make the image darker or noisier. Reolink recommends leaving it on Auto unless you have a specific problem.
exposure.requires: Cameras that report the exposure setting

sources.title: How to Configure Exposure and Backlight Settings

exposure.notes: Disabled by default in Home Assistant; enable the entity to use it. Gain and shutter ranges cannot be set from Home Assistant; set them in the Reolink app/client.

floodlight_event_mode.title: Floodlight event mode
floodlight_event_mode.summary: What the floodlight does when the camera detects an event: nothing, stay on, or flash.
floodlight_event_mode.what_it_does: Sets the floodlight's event-triggered behaviour (Baichuan floodlight `event_mode`): Off, On (stays lit for the event on time) or Flash (flashes for the event flash time). This is separate from the Floodlight mode used for normal night lighting.
floodlight_event_mode.tradeoffs: Flash is a stronger deterrent but more noticeable to neighbours; Off means detections no longer trigger the light.
floodlight_event_mode.requires: Cameras with a floodlight that supports event lighting

sources.title: FAQs for Reolink Elite Floodlight Series

floodlight_event_mode.notes: Reolink calls this Light Alert (Stay On / Continuous Flashing) in the app.

floodlight_mode.title: Floodlight mode
floodlight_mode.summary: When the floodlight or spotlight turns on by itself (off, on detection at night, all night, on a schedule, and more).
floodlight_mode.what_it_does: Sets the camera's floodlight mode (SetWhiteLed `mode`). Reolink documents Off; Auto (Night Smart Mode: on at night when an event is detected); On at night (on from dusk until it gets light); and Schedule (Timer Mode: on during the floodlight schedule). Adaptive modes adjust brightness to ambient light. The Floodlight light entity overrides this while it is on.
floodlight_mode.tradeoffs: Always-on and schedule modes light the area continuously; Off can leave colour night video dark on cameras that rely on the light.
floodlight_mode.requires: Cameras with a floodlight or spotlight
floodlight_mode.impact_note: On or Schedule can light the scene at once; Off can leave colour night video dark.

sources.title: How to Configure Spotlight Settings for Your Camera

post_rec_time.title: Post-recording time

battery.title: Battery
battery.summary: Shows the battery charge level in percent.
battery.what_it_does: Reports the battery percentage (reolink-aio `battery_percentage`, from GetBatteryInfo).

sources.title: Reolink: How to Check Battery Status on Reolink App

battery.notes: Diagnostic, enabled by default. No translation key (device class battery). Push-updated. Reolink notes cold weather (below -10°C) can show a low battery level.

battery_state.title: Battery state
battery_state.summary: Shows whether the battery is discharging, charging, or fully charged.
battery_state.what_it_does: Reports the charge status (reolink-aio `battery_status`, from GetBatteryInfo `chargeStatus`): discharging, charging or charge complete.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Check Battery Status on Reolink App

battery_state.notes: Diagnostic, disabled by default. Push-updated. reolink-aio reports 'discharging' when no battery info is available.

battery_temperature.title: Battery temperature
battery_temperature.what_it_does: Reports the battery temperature (reolink-aio `battery_temperature`, from GetBatteryInfo).
battery_temperature.tradeoffs: Reolink battery cameras do not charge outside their charging temperature range, so this can explain a camera that stops charging.

sources.title: Reolink: The Charging Temperature of Reolink Battery-Powered Cameras

cpu_usage.title: CPU usage
cpu_usage.summary: Shows the device's CPU load in percent.
cpu_usage.what_it_does: Reports the device's CPU use (reolink-aio `cpu_usage`, from GetPerformance `cpuUsed`).
cpu_usage.tradeoffs: High CPU can coincide with dropped connections, e.g. from several streaming clients or fast polling.
cpu_usage.requires: Devices that report performance data (host device only)

day_night_state.title: Day night state
day_night_state.summary: Shows whether the image is currently in color, black & white, or color with floodlight.
day_night_state.what_it_does: Reports the camera's current image mode (reolink-aio `baichuan.day_night_state`): Color (day), Black & white (night, IR) or Color with floodlight (led_day). In Auto mode the camera switches to black & white in low light.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Change Day and Night Mode via Reolink App

hdd_storage.title: HDD storage
hdd_storage.summary: Shows how full one hard drive in the NVR is, in percent.
hdd_storage.what_it_does: Reports used storage as a percentage of capacity for one HDD (reolink-aio `hdd_storage`, from GetHddInfo). One entity per drive, numbered by index.
hdd_storage.tradeoffs: A full drive is normal when overwrite is on (old footage is replaced); check overwrite settings if recording stops.

sources.title: Reolink: Will Reolink Device Overwrite Old Files When it's Full

hdd_storage.notes: Diagnostic, disabled by default. Unavailable when the drive is not formatted or mounted. Polled.

person_type.title: Person type
person_type.summary: Shows the kind of person the camera's AI last classified (man, woman or child).
person_type.what_it_does: Reports the AI sub-type for person detections (reolink-aio `baichuan.ai_detect_type(ch, "person")`). Possible values: man, woman, child.
person_type.requires: Cameras with AI object sub-type classification
person_type.notes: Push-updated. Reolink does not document this sub-type classification in its support articles.

ptz_pan_position.title: PTZ pan position
ptz_pan_position.summary: Shows the PTZ camera's current horizontal (pan) position.
ptz_pan_position.what_it_does: Reports the pan position value from the camera (reolink-aio `ptz_pan_position`, GetPtzCurPos `Ppos`).
ptz_pan_position.notes: Diagnostic. Raw camera units with no unit of measurement; Reolink does not document the scale. Push-updated.

ptz_tilt_position.title: PTZ tilt position
ptz_tilt_position.summary: Shows the PTZ camera's current vertical (tilt) position.
ptz_tilt_position.what_it_does: Reports the tilt position value from the camera (reolink-aio `ptz_tilt_position`, GetPtzCurPos `Tpos`).
ptz_tilt_position.notes: Diagnostic. Raw camera units with no unit of measurement; Reolink does not document the scale. Push-updated.

sd_storage.title: SD storage
sd_storage.summary: Shows how full the SD card is, in percent.
sd_storage.what_it_does: Reports used storage as a percentage of capacity for one SD card (reolink-aio `hdd_storage`, from GetHddInfo, storage type SD). One entity per card, numbered by index.
sd_storage.tradeoffs: A full card is normal when overwrite is on (old footage is replaced); check overwrite settings if recording stops.
sd_storage.requires: Cameras or Home Hubs with an SD card

sources.title: Reolink: How to Check/Format the microSD Card in Reolink Device
Reolink: Will Reolink Device Overwrite Old Files When it's Full

sd_storage.notes: Diagnostic, disabled by default. Unavailable when the card is not formatted or mounted. Polled.

vehicle_type.title: Vehicle type
vehicle_type.summary: Shows the kind of vehicle the camera's AI last classified.
vehicle_type.what_it_does: Reports the AI sub-type for vehicle detections (reolink-aio `baichuan.ai_detect_type(ch, "vehicle")`). Possible values: sedan, SUV, pickup truck, bus, van, truck, motorcycle.
vehicle_type.requires: Cameras with AI object sub-type classification
vehicle_type.notes: Push-updated. Reolink does not document this sub-type classification in its support articles.

wifi_signal.title: Wi-Fi signal
wifi_signal.summary: Shows the Wi-Fi signal strength of the camera or NVR/Hub in dBm.
wifi_signal.what_it_does: Reports the Wi-Fi signal in dBm (reolink-aio `wifi_signal`). Values are negative; closer to 0 is stronger (e.g. -39 dBm is stronger than -65 dBm).
wifi_signal.tradeoffs: Weak signal causes dropouts and lag; Reolink suggests moving closer to the router or adding an extender.
wifi_signal.requires: Wi-Fi cameras; for a host, only when it is connected over Wi-Fi

sources.title: Reolink: How to Check WiFi Signal Strength of Reolink Cameras via Reolink App

siren.title: Siren
siren.summary: Sounds the camera's or hub's siren now.
siren.what_it_does: Turning on plays the siren until turned off. With a duration, Home Assistant passes it to reolink-aio as a repeat count, not seconds (`AudioAlarmPlay` `alarm_mode` "times", roughly 5 seconds per repeat in reolink-aio). With a volume, a camera first calls `set_volume`, which permanently changes the camera's speaker volume (the Volume number entity). Some models take up to 5 seconds to go quiet after turn-off.
siren.tradeoffs: A volume set while sounding the siren stays afterwards and also changes normal camera audio such as two-way talk and alerts.
siren.requires: Cameras with a siren; Home Hubs (hub siren, turn-on only)
siren.impact_note: Makes a loud alarm sound. Setting a volume also permanently changes the camera speaker volume.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Manually Trigger the Siren of your Camera
Reolink: Introduction to the Reolink Siren Alarm of Home Hub/Home Hub Pro

siren.notes: The Home Hub siren entity supports turn-on and volume only. On a Home Hub, turning on with a volume only sets the hub alarm volume (`set_hub_audio`) and does not sound the siren; turning on without a volume sounds it.

auto_focus.title: Auto focus
auto_focus.summary: Lets a zoom camera focus by itself.
auto_focus.what_it_does: Turns the camera's automatic focus on or off (reolink-aio `SetAutoFocus`). Reolink describes it as deciding whether the camera refocuses on its own, for example after startup or a reboot; with it off you set focus by hand.
auto_focus.tradeoffs: With it off the image stays blurry after zoom changes until you adjust focus manually.
auto_focus.requires: Cameras with optical zoom / motorized focus
auto_focus.notes: Reolink says the camera does not refocus during pan/tilt, only during zoom.

auto_tracking.title: Auto tracking
auto_tracking.summary: PTZ camera follows a detected person, vehicle or animal.
auto_tracking.what_it_does: When on, the camera pans/tilts (or digitally tracks, on TrackMix) to follow a detected target, then returns to its starting position after the target stops or disappears for the set times (reolink-aio `SetAiCfg`).
auto_tracking.tradeoffs: Keeps the subject in view but moves the camera away from its normal view; Reolink's troubleshooting advice suggests manual PTZ use can delay tracking.
auto_tracking.requires: PTZ cameras with auto tracking (e.g. TrackMix, some PT models)
auto_tracking.impact_note: The camera moves on its own to follow targets, away from its fixed view.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up Auto Tracking for Reolink Cameras

auto_tracking.notes: Reolink applies its tracking schedule and target types set in the app.

doorbell_button_sound.title: Doorbell button sound
doorbell_button_sound.summary: Plays a short tone from the doorbell itself when the button is pressed.
doorbell_button_sound.what_it_does: Turns the doorbell's own button-press tone on or off (reolink-aio `set_volume` with `visitorLoudspeaker`). This is the sound the visitor hears at the door, not the indoor chime or phone notification.
doorbell_button_sound.tradeoffs: Turning it off gives the visitor no audible feedback that the press worked.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Enable/Disable the Ringtone on the Doorbell

email.title: Email on event
email.summary: Sends email alerts when the camera detects an event.
email.what_it_does: Enables or disables email alerts for this camera or NVR (reolink-aio `SetEmail`/`SetEmailV20`). Email server, recipients and schedule must first be set up in the Reolink app/client. For NVRs there is a global switch on the NVR device and one per camera channel; the feature only works for a channel when both are on (same as the Reolink app).
email.requires: Cameras and NVRs with email configured (global switch on NVRs, per-channel on NVRs and Home Hubs)

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up E-mail for Reolink Products

ftp_upload.title: FTP upload
ftp_upload.summary: Uploads recordings/snapshots to your FTP server.
ftp_upload.what_it_does: Enables or disables FTP upload for this camera or NVR (reolink-aio `SetFtp`/`SetFtpV20`). The FTP server and upload schedule must first be set up in the Reolink app/client. For NVRs there is a global switch on the NVR device and one per camera channel; the feature only works for a channel when both are on (same as the Reolink app).
ftp_upload.requires: Cameras and NVRs with FTP configured (global switch on NVRs, per-channel on NVRs and Home Hubs)
ftp_upload.impact_note: Stops off-site copies of recordings going to the FTP server.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up FTP for Reolink Products

ftp_upload.notes: Reolink devices do not support SFTP.

guard_return.title: Guard return
guard_return.summary: PTZ camera goes back to its guard (monitor) position when idle.
guard_return.what_it_does: When on, the camera returns to the saved guard position after it has not been moved and nothing was detected for the Guard return time (reolink-aio `SetPtzGuard` `benable`).
guard_return.tradeoffs: Keeps the camera on its monitored spot, but it will leave a view you set manually once the return time passes.
guard_return.requires: PTZ cameras with a guard/monitor point
guard_return.impact_note: With guard return on, the camera moves back to its guard position on its own after the return time, away from wherever it was pointed.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up Monitor Point for Reolink Devices

guard_return.notes: Reads as off unless a guard position has been saved. Reolink calls this the monitor point.

hardwired_chime_enabled.title: Hardwired chime enabled
hardwired_chime_enabled.summary: Lets the doorbell ring an existing wired indoor chime.
hardwired_chime_enabled.what_it_does: Turns the doorbell's control of a hardwired (mechanical/electronic) chime on or off (Baichuan `DingDongCtrl`, keeping the stored chime type). Reolink does not document this exact switch; in the app the related settings are under Chime > Existing Chime Settings.
hardwired_chime_enabled.tradeoffs: Off means the wired chime will not ring when the button is pressed.
hardwired_chime_enabled.requires: Doorbells wired to a hardwired chime
hardwired_chime_enabled.impact_note: The indoor wired chime stops ringing for visitors.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Connect Reolink Video Doorbell (Battery) to Existing Wired Chime System

hardwired_chime_enabled.notes: Disabled by default in HA. Its state is polled only once (about 1 minute after start-up) because polling can make the chime rattle.

hdr.title: HDR
hdr.summary: Leftover HDR switch name; HDR is now controlled by the HDR select.
hdr.what_it_does: HA 2026.10.1 still ships this translation, but switch.py no longer creates an HDR switch. HDR (off/on/auto) is set through the HDR select entity (reolink-aio `set_HDR`).
hdr.notes: No entity is created for this key in HA 2026.10.1; only an old registry entry could show it.

hub_ringtone_on_event.title: Hub ringtone on event
hub_ringtone_on_event.summary: The Home Hub/NVR sounds an alarm tone when this camera detects an event.
hub_ringtone_on_event.what_it_does: Enables or disables the hub/NVR buzzer or ringtone for events (reolink-aio `SetBuzzerAlarmV20`). Which tone plays and when follow the hub's ringtone and schedule settings. For NVRs there is a global switch on the NVR device and one per camera channel; the feature only works for a channel when both are on (same as the Reolink app).
hub_ringtone_on_event.tradeoffs: Useful as an indoor alert, but it makes noise at the hub/NVR for every matching event.
hub_ringtone_on_event.requires: NVRs (global switch) and channels of NVRs and Home Hubs
hub_ringtone_on_event.impact_note: The hub/NVR plays a loud alarm tone on events.

sources.title: Reolink: Introduction to the Reolink Siren Alarm of Home Hub/Home Hub Pro
Reolink: How to Enable/Disable Alarm Buzzer for PoE NVRs

ir_lights.title: Infrared lights in night mode
ir_lights.summary: Lets the infrared LEDs come on for night vision.
ir_lights.what_it_does: On: the IR LEDs turn on whenever the camera is in night (black & white) mode. Off: the IR LEDs always stay off (reolink-aio `SetIrLights` Auto/Off).
ir_lights.tradeoffs: Turning it off avoids glare/reflections through glass but night images may be very dark.
ir_lights.impact_note: Night video can become unusable without infrared light.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Enable/Disable IR Lights for Reolink Cameras

ir_lights.notes: Reolink's article says its steps apply to all cameras except the RLC-812A, RLC-824A, CX410, CX410W, CX810 and E1 Outdoor CX, which do not offer this option.

led.title: LED
led.summary: Status light on a Reolink Chime.
led.what_it_does: Turns the status LED on the Reolink Chime on or off (reolink-aio chime `DingDongOpt` `ledState`).
led.requires: Reolink Chime paired with a doorbell

sources.title: Reolink: Configuration Guide: How to Set Up Reolink Chime

led.notes: Shown in HA docs as 'Chime LED'; it belongs to the chime device.

manual_record.title: Manual record
manual_record.summary: Starts a recording right now, regardless of schedule.
manual_record.what_it_does: When turned on, the camera starts a manual recording to its SD card/NVR storage; it stops when turned off or automatically after 10 minutes (reolink-aio `SetManualRec`, duration 600 s).
manual_record.tradeoffs: Uses storage; on battery cameras recording keeps the camera awake and drains the battery.
manual_record.requires: Cameras and NVR channels that support manual recording
manual_record.impact_note: Keeps the camera recording; drains battery cameras.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Manually Record via Reolink NVR (New UI)

manual_record.notes: Supports push updates. Switches itself off after 10 minutes.

pir_enabled.title: PIR enabled
pir_enabled.summary: Turns the PIR (heat-motion) sensor on or off.
pir_enabled.what_it_does: Enables or disables the passive infrared motion sensor that wakes battery cameras and triggers their motion events (reolink-aio `SetPirInfo` `enable`).
pir_enabled.tradeoffs: Off saves battery, but the camera will not wake or record on motion.
pir_enabled.requires: Cameras with a PIR sensor (mainly battery cameras)
pir_enabled.impact_note: Stops PIR motion detection, so motion events and recordings stop.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Turn on/off the PIR Sensor

pir_enabled.notes: Disabled by default in HA. Reolink enables PIR by default on battery cameras.

pir_reduce_alarm.title: PIR reduce false alarm
pir_reduce_alarm.summary: PIR filter that ignores some false triggers.
pir_reduce_alarm.what_it_does: Turns on the PIR sensor's 'reduce false alarms' option (reolink-aio `SetPirInfo` `reduceAlarm`). Reolink says it helps cut triggers from waving objects on cameras with a digital PIR.
pir_reduce_alarm.tradeoffs: May miss some real but brief or small motion.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Configure the PIR Motion Sensor Settings for Reolink Go Ranger PT/KEEN Ranger PT
Reolink: PIR False Alarms of Reolink Battery-powered Cameras

pre_record.title: Pre-recording
pre_record.summary: Keeps a short buffer so recordings include the seconds before an event.
pre_record.what_it_does: Enables pre-motion recording (Baichuan pre-record setting): the camera keeps buffering video so each event clip starts before the trigger. On supported battery cameras it pauses below the battery threshold.
pre_record.tradeoffs: Captures the lead-up to an event, but on battery cameras it uses noticeably more power.
pre_record.requires: Supported battery cameras (e.g. Altas series) and some other models
pre_record.impact_note: Raises battery drain on battery cameras.

sources.title: Reolink: Introduction to Reolink Pre-Motion Recording of Battery-Powered Cameras

pre_record.notes: Reolink: battery doorbell (2nd Gen) pre-recording needs Wired Power Mode.

pre_siren_on_event.title: Pre-siren on event
pre_siren_on_event.summary: Plays a short warning tone before the siren on detection.
pre_siren_on_event.what_it_does: Enables the pre-alarm tone that sounds when the camera detects motion, before deciding whether to sound the full siren (reolink-aio `SetAudioCfg` `preAlarm`). Only takes effect when Siren on event is on.
pre_siren_on_event.tradeoffs: Can sound on any motion, even when the siren itself does not fire.
pre_siren_on_event.requires: Cameras with pre-siren support (battery cameras with smart detection)
pre_siren_on_event.impact_note: Makes a warning sound outdoors on motion.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up Siren for Your Camera

privacy_mask.title: Privacy mask
privacy_mask.summary: Blacks out the areas you drew as privacy masks.
privacy_mask.what_it_does: Turns the configured privacy-mask rectangles on or off (reolink-aio `SetMask`). Masked areas appear black in live view and recordings.
privacy_mask.tradeoffs: Hidden areas are not recorded. Reolink does not document whether motion in a masked area is still detected; exclude it from the detection zone if that matters.
privacy_mask.requires: Cameras with a privacy mask already drawn in the Reolink app/client
privacy_mask.impact_note: Parts of the image are hidden from live view and recordings.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up Privacy Mask for Reolink Cameras

privacy_mask.notes: Only created when a mask exists; reload the integration after drawing the first mask.

privacy_mask_lens.title: Privacy mask lens
privacy_mask_lens.summary: Privacy mask for one lens of a dual-lens camera.
privacy_mask_lens.what_it_does: Same as Privacy mask, but for a single lens of a dual-lens camera (reolink-aio `SetMask` on that lens's channel).
privacy_mask_lens.tradeoffs: Hidden areas are not recorded. Reolink does not document whether motion in a masked area is still detected; exclude it from the detection zone if that matters.
privacy_mask_lens.requires: Dual-lens cameras with a privacy mask drawn
privacy_mask_lens.impact_note: Parts of that lens's image are hidden from live view and recordings.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up Privacy Mask for Reolink Cameras

privacy_mode.title: Privacy mode
privacy_mode.summary: Shuts the camera's video and alarms off for privacy.
privacy_mode.what_it_does: When on, the camera stops live view, streams and alarms and shuts down its API, so almost all other entities become unavailable until it is turned off (Baichuan `SetPrivacyMode`).
privacy_mode.tradeoffs: Full privacy, but no recording, detection or notifications while on.
privacy_mode.requires: Cameras with Privacy Mode (e.g. E1 series)
privacy_mode.impact_note: Stops streaming, recording, detection and alerts.

sources.title: Reolink: Introduction to Reolink Privacy Mode

privacy_mode.notes: Stays available while on. Turn it off before changing other settings in automations. The German version of Reolink's article says only the super admin account can turn it on or off; the English text was not checked. Whether the camera restarts when it changes is not confirmed.

ptz_patrol.title: PTZ patrol
ptz_patrol.summary: Starts or stops the camera touring its preset positions.
ptz_patrol.what_it_does: On starts the PTZ patrol, which moves the camera through the preset positions configured in the Reolink app/client; off stops it (reolink-aio `PtzCtrl` `StartPatrol`/`StopPatrol`, first configured patrol).
ptz_patrol.tradeoffs: Covers more area, but the camera is not watching any single spot continuously.
ptz_patrol.requires: PTZ cameras with patrol positions configured
ptz_patrol.impact_note: Moves the camera away from its current view.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up Patrol for Reolink Device

ptz_patrol.notes: Only created when patrol positions exist; restart the integration after adding them the first time.

push_notifications.title: Push notifications
push_notifications.summary: Sends Reolink app push alerts for events.
push_notifications.what_it_does: Enables or disables push notifications from this camera/NVR to phones (reolink-aio `SetPush`/`SetPushV20`). A phone only gets them if this switch is on (for NVRs both global and channel) and push is on in that phone's Reolink app. For NVRs there is a global switch on the NVR device and one per camera channel; the feature only works for a channel when both are on (same as the Reolink app).
push_notifications.requires: Cameras, NVRs and Home Hub channels
push_notifications.impact_note: Stops event alerts to every phone.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Enable Push Notifications on iOS and Android Phones
Reolink: How to Enable/Disable Push Notification for Cameras Connected to NVR

push_notifications.notes: Per-phone push settings in the Reolink app are independent of this switch.

record.title: Record
record.what_it_does: Enables or disables recording according to the recording schedule (reolink-aio `SetRec`/`SetRecV20`). For NVRs there is a global switch on the NVR device and one per camera channel; the feature only works for a channel when both are on (same as the Reolink app). Reolink: the NVR master switch stops all cameras regardless of schedule.
record.requires: Cameras with storage, NVRs (global and per channel) and Home Hub channels

sources.title: Reolink: How to Disable/Stop Recording on Reolink Devices

record_audio.title: Record audio
record_audio.what_it_does: Turns the audio track of the camera's encoded streams on or off (reolink-aio `SetEnc` `audio`). Reolink: with it off, recordings have no sound; on some models live audio is affected too.
record_audio.tradeoffs: Off avoids recording conversations where that is a legal or privacy concern.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Enable/Disable Record Audio via Reolink NVR (New UI)
Reolink: How to Enable Audio for Recording and Live Viewing via Reolink Software

record_audio.notes: Reolink notes two-way audio may not be heard on the client side with it off.

rule.title: Surveillance rule
rule.summary: Turns one of the camera's surveillance rules on or off.
rule.what_it_does: Enables or disables a single surveillance (IFTTT-style linkage) rule created in the Reolink app, e.g. a motion alarm or scheduled action (Baichuan rule `enable`). One switch per rule, named after the rule.
rule.requires: Cameras with surveillance rules configured (e.g. Reolink Professional series)
rule.impact_note: The actions the rule triggers (alarms, outputs, recording) stop.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up Surveillance Rule for Reolink Professional Series Cameras

rule.notes: Name includes the rule name. What the rule does depends on how it was set up in the app.

siren_on_event.title: Siren on event
siren_on_event.summary: Sounds the camera's siren when it detects an event.
siren_on_event.what_it_does: Enables the siren alarm for detections, following the siren schedule and detection types set in the Reolink app (reolink-aio `SetAudioAlarm`/`SetAudioAlarmV20`).
siren_on_event.tradeoffs: A strong deterrent, but loud and can annoy neighbours on false alarms.
siren_on_event.impact_note: The camera plays a loud siren on detections.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Set up Siren for Your Camera

siren_on_event.notes: Reolink: Video Doorbell (Battery) cannot sound the siren on motion.

tamper_enabled.title: Tamper alarm
tamper_enabled.summary: Alerts when the device is pried off or moved.
tamper_enabled.what_it_does: Enables tamper detection (Baichuan tamper setting). Reolink describes it on doorbells: a sensor watches the mounting angle and, if it changes, the device sounds a siren, flashes red, sends a push and records the event.
tamper_enabled.tradeoffs: Reolink advises enabling it only after installation to avoid false alarms.
tamper_enabled.requires: Devices with a tamper sensor (e.g. Reolink Video Doorbell 2nd Gen, D340B V2)

sources.title: Reolink: How Does Reolink Doorbell's Tamper Alert Function Work?

floodlight_schedule_end.title: Floodlight schedule end
floodlight_schedule_end.summary: Time the floodlight's daily schedule ends.
floodlight_schedule_end.what_it_does: Sets when the floodlight schedule ends (reolink-aio `SetWhiteLed` LightingSchedule). Setting it also switches Floodlight mode to Schedule, and if the window covers the current time the light turns on immediately.
floodlight_schedule_end.tradeoffs: Schedule mode replaces motion-triggered (Auto) floodlight behaviour.
floodlight_schedule_end.requires: Cameras with a floodlight that support Schedule mode
floodlight_schedule_end.impact_note: Every change switches the floodlight to Schedule mode and may turn it on immediately.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Configure Spotlight Settings for Your Camera

floodlight_schedule_end.notes: Disabled by default in HA. Supports push updates. Times use the camera's own clock and time zone (24-hour HH:MM); windows across midnight work.

floodlight_schedule_start.title: Floodlight schedule start
floodlight_schedule_start.summary: Time the floodlight's daily schedule starts.
floodlight_schedule_start.what_it_does: Sets when the floodlight schedule starts (reolink-aio `SetWhiteLed` LightingSchedule). Setting it also switches Floodlight mode to Schedule, and if the window covers the current time the light turns on immediately.
floodlight_schedule_start.tradeoffs: Schedule mode replaces motion-triggered (Auto) floodlight behaviour.
floodlight_schedule_start.requires: Cameras with a floodlight that support Schedule mode
floodlight_schedule_start.impact_note: Every change switches the floodlight to Schedule mode and may turn it on immediately.

sources.title: Reolink: How to Configure Spotlight Settings for Your Camera

floodlight_schedule_start.notes: Disabled by default in HA. Supports push updates. Times use the camera's own clock and time zone (24-hour HH:MM); windows across midnight work.

firmware.title: Firmware
firmware.summary: Shows the installed firmware and installs a newer version when one is available.
firmware.what_it_does: Checks for new firmware every 24 hours, both through the device API and the Reolink download center, and installs it when you press Install (reolink-aio `update_firmware`). When release notes are available it also shows them with a link to the firmware zip for manual installation.
firmware.tradeoffs: HA can find updates the Reolink app does not show. Keep power and network connected during the update, as Reolink advises.
firmware.requires: Any Reolink device that reports firmware info (NVR/Home Hub and each attached camera get their own entity)
firmware.impact_note: Installing firmware takes the device offline while it updates; recording, streaming and detection stop until it is back.
